name: pq-connectors
description: Find how Microsoft's certified Power Query connectors implement things, maintain the connector archive and its pattern guides, and read or write the OKF bundle (includes the official okf-generate and okf-consume skills).

interface.shortDescription: Look up and maintain certified Power Query connector code
interface.longDescription: Use find-connector-code to answer how certified connectors implement authentication, paging, navigation, folding, and errors. Use refresh-archive, review-pattern, and run-candidate-reviews to maintain the archive. okf-generate and okf-consume are the official Open Knowledge Format skills.
defaultPrompt: How do certified Power Query connectors implement cursor paging?
Refresh the connector archive and fix any failing checks.
